## v1.12.9

### Changes

2026-09-17 · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/releases/tag/v1.12.9)

#### Features 🎉
* feat(computer): support desktop swipe gestures by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3144
* feat(core): expose device adapter schema and types by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3153
* feat(report): support mobile steps and player views by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3155
* feat(report): support portable step selectors by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3159
* feat(test): support native ESM project configs by @quanru in https://github.com/web-infra-dev/midscene/pull/3154
